levels.title: Two-number addition
levels.rules: Operands independently sampled from [0, 10]; sums can reach 20.

levels.title: Nonnegative subtraction
levels.rules: Sample m,n in [0, 10]; display (m+n) - m. Minuends can reach 20; results are nonnegative.

levels.title: Addition and subtraction
levels.rules: Mix levels 1 and 2; displayed subtraction operands can reach 20.

levels.title: Three-number addition
levels.rules: Three operands in [0, 10]; sums can reach 30.

levels.title: Nonnegative chained subtraction
levels.rules: Sample m,n,p in [0, 10]; display (m+n+p) - m - n; results are nonnegative.

levels.title: Chained addition or subtraction
levels.rules: Mix levels 4 and 5; displayed minuends can reach 30.

levels.title: Three-number mixed addition/subtraction
levels.rules: Sample a,b,c in [0, 10]; mix a+(b+c)-b, (a+c)-a+b, and a+b+c; results are nonnegative.

levels.title: Subtraction with signed minuends
levels.rules: First operand in [-15, 15], second in [0, 15]; results can be negative.

levels.title: Subtraction and negative-number addition
levels.rules: Mix x-y with x,y in [0,15] and x+y with x in [-15,-1], y in [0,15].

levels.title: Signed two-number addition/subtraction
levels.rules: Mix negative-leading addition/subtraction with x in [-15,-1], y in [0,15], and subtraction with both in [0,15].

levels.title: Signed chained subtraction
levels.rules: First operand in [-10,10], remaining operands in [0,10].

levels.title: Three-number addition/subtraction
levels.rules: Three operands in [0,10]; use + and - once each.

levels.title: Negative leading operand
levels.rules: First operand in [-10,-1], remaining operands in [0,10]; use + and - once each.

levels.title: Adding or subtracting a negative number
levels.rules: First operand in [0,20], second in [-20,-1]; choose + or -.

levels.title: Two negative operands
levels.rules: Both operands in [-20,-1]; choose + or -.

levels.title: Three signed addends
levels.rules: Three operands in [-15,15]; add all three.

levels.title: Addition missing number
levels.rules: Two visible values independently sampled from [0,40]; one is the right-hand result; missing value can be negative.

levels.title: Subtraction missing number
levels.rules: Two visible values independently sampled from [0,40]; one is the right-hand result; missing value can be negative.

levels.title: Addition/subtraction missing number
levels.rules: Two visible values in [0,40]; choose + or -; one visible value is the right-hand result.

levels.title: Smaller-range missing number
levels.rules: Two visible values in [0,30]; choose + or -; one visible value is the right-hand result.

levels.title: Fixed second missing number
levels.rules: Visible left value in [-30,30], right-hand result in [0,30]; blank is the second operand.

levels.title: Three-number missing number
levels.rules: Three visible values in [0,30]; the final one is the result; use + and - once each and insert a blank on the left.

levels.title: Signed leading operand missing number
levels.rules: First visible value in [-30,30], other visible values in [0,30]; the final value is the result; fixed - then +.

levels.title: Signed three-number missing number
levels.rules: Three visible values in [-30,30]; the final one is the result; use + and - once each and insert a blank on the left.

levels.title: Single-digit nonnegative multiplication
levels.rules: Two factors in [0,9].

levels.title: Single-digit signed multiplication
levels.rules: Two factors in [-9,9].

levels.title: Nonnegative missing factor
levels.rules: Sample two factors in [0,9], calculate their product, then hide the second factor.

levels.title: Signed missing factor
levels.rules: Sample two factors in [-9,9], calculate their product, then hide the second factor.

levels.title: Single-digit nonnegative division
levels.rules: Divisor and quotient in [0,9]; derive the dividend from their product. Teaching mode may include a zero divisor.

levels.title: Single-digit signed division
levels.rules: Divisor and quotient in [-9,9]; derive the dividend from their product. Teaching mode may include a zero divisor.

levels.title: Nonnegative division missing number
levels.rules: Divisor and quotient in [0,9]; derive dividend, then hide divisor or dividend.

levels.title: Signed division missing number
levels.rules: Divisor and quotient in [-9,9]; derive dividend, then hide divisor or dividend.

levels.title: Add or subtract two products
levels.rules: Four factors in [-9,9]; add or subtract the two products.

levels.title: Two products missing factor
levels.rules: Four source factors in [-9,9]; compute the result then hide a factor.

levels.title: Product plus or minus quotient
levels.rules: Factors, quotient, and divisor in [-9,9]; derive the dividend. Choose + or - between the product and quotient.

levels.title: Product and quotient missing number
levels.rules: Source factors, quotient, and divisor in [-9,9]; derive the result; hide a multiplier, divisor, or dividend.

levels.title: Multiply a parenthesized sum/difference
levels.rules: Three operands in [-9,9]; multiply one operand by a parenthesized sum or difference.

levels.title: Parenthesized missing number
levels.rules: Three source values in [-9,9]; compute (x +/- y)*z, then hide y.

levels.title: Multiply two parenthesized expressions
levels.rules: Four operands in [-9,9]; independently choose + or - within each pair of parentheses.

levels.title: Two parentheses missing number
levels.rules: Four source operands in [-9,9]; compute the product of the parentheses, then hide the second left term.

levels.title: Three signed factors
levels.rules: Three factors in [-9,9].

levels.title: Three factors missing number
levels.rules: Three factors in [-9,9]; compute their product, then hide the second or third factor.

levels.title: Larger signed multiplication
levels.rules: Two factors in [-30,30].

levels.title: Larger missing factor
levels.rules: Two source factors in [-30,30]; compute their product then hide the second factor.

levels.title: Larger exact division
levels.rules: Divisor and quotient in [-30,30]; derive dividend as their product.

levels.title: Larger division missing number
levels.rules: Divisor and quotient in [-30,30]; derive dividend then hide divisor or dividend.

levels.title: Four nonnegative operands
levels.rules: Four source operands in [0,30]; choose three distinct operations. If division is selected, adjust the dividend/divisor to make that local pair integral; the whole expression need not be an integer.

levels.title: Four signed operands
levels.rules: Four source operands in [-30,30]; choose three distinct operations. Adjust the local division pair; the whole expression need not be an integer.

levels.title: Four nonnegative operands missing number
levels.rules: Four source operands in [0,30]; choose three distinct operations, adjust the division pair, compute the exact result, then hide an operand.

levels.title: Four signed operands missing number
levels.rules: Four source operands in [-30,30]; choose three distinct operations, adjust the division pair, compute the exact result, then hide an operand.

levels.title: Nonnegative fraction addition/subtraction
levels.rules: Two fractions: numerator in [0,20], denominator in [1,20]; choose + or -.

levels.title: Three nonnegative fractions
levels.rules: Three fractions: numerator in [0,20], denominator in [1,20]; use + and - once each.

levels.title: Three fractions missing number
levels.rules: Three visible fractions with numerator in [0,20], denominator in [1,20]; the last is the result; insert a left-side blank and use + and - once each.

levels.title: Fraction multiplication
levels.rules: Two fractions: numerator in [-20,20], denominator in [1,20]; multiply.

levels.title: Fraction division
levels.rules: Two fractions: numerator in [-20,20], denominator in [1,20]; divide.

levels.title: Three fractions with multiplication/division
levels.rules: Three fractions: numerator in [-10,10], denominator in [1,10]; use multiplication and division once each.

levels.title: Fraction multiplication/division missing number
levels.rules: Three visible fractions with numerator in [-10,10], denominator in [1,10]; last is the result; insert a blank and use multiplication and division once each.

levels.title: Four fractions with mixed operations
levels.rules: Four fractions: numerator in [-10,10], denominator in [1,10]; choose three distinct operations.

levels.title: Four fractions missing number
levels.rules: Four visible fractions: numerator in [-10,10], denominator in [1,10]; last is the result; insert a blank and choose three distinct operations.

levels.title: One-decimal-place addition/subtraction
levels.rules: Two one-decimal-place values in [-20,20]; choose + or -.

levels.title: Mixed numeric types with addition/subtraction
levels.rules: Three independently mixed integer/decimal/fraction operands. Integer range [-10,10]; decimals up to two places in [-10,10]; fraction numerators [-10,10], denominators [1,10]. Use + and - once each.

levels.title: Mixed addition/subtraction missing number
levels.rules: Three visible mixed values: integers and up-to-two-place decimals in [-20,20], fraction numerators [-20,20] and denominators [1,20]. Last value is the result; insert a blank, use + and - once each.

levels.title: One-decimal-place multiplication
levels.rules: Two one-decimal-place values in [-20,20]; multiply.

levels.title: Decimal division from factors
levels.rules: Sample a one-decimal-place divisor and quotient in [-10,10]; derive the dividend (up to two decimal places).

levels.title: Mixed numeric types with multiplication/division
levels.rules: Three mixed operands: integers and one-place decimals in [-10,10], fraction numerators [-10,10] and denominators [1,10]. Fixed multiplication then division.

levels.title: Mixed multiplication/division missing number
levels.rules: Three visible mixed values: integers and one-place decimals in [-20,20], fraction numerators [-20,20] and denominators [1,20]. Last value is the result; insert a blank; fixed multiplication then division.

levels.title: Four mixed numeric operands
levels.rules: Four mixed operands: integers and up-to-two-place decimals in [-10,10], fraction numerators [-10,10] and denominators [1,10]. Choose three distinct operations.

levels.title: Four mixed operands missing number
levels.rules: Four visible mixed values: integers and up-to-two-place decimals in [-10,10], fraction numerators [-10,10] and denominators [1,10]. Last value is the result; insert a blank and choose three distinct operations.
